projects.name: Smoking & Drinking Prediction Platform
projects.description: Independent data, analytics, and ML project that validated a large-scale data pipeline, trained classification models for smoking and drinking prediction, and published stakeholder-facing delivery artifacts.
projects.impact: Processed 991,346 health-screening records, retained 991,320 valid rows (invalid rate below 0.003%); models reached 70.3% smoking prediction accuracy and 73.3% drinking prediction accuracy; published analytical tables and Looker Studio dashboards.
projects.evidence_text: Smoking & Drinking Prediction Platform - Independent data, analytics, and ML project - Python, scikit-learn, SQL, BigQuery, Dataform, Cloud Workflows, Looker Studio, Astro. Validated large-scale data pipeline: Processed 991,346 health-screening records, retained 991,320 valid rows, and reduced invalid records to only 26, for an invalid rate below 0.003%. Modeling and automation: Built reproducible workflows with Python, SQL, BigQuery, Dataform, and Cloud Workflows; trained classification models that reached 70.3% smoking prediction accuracy and 73.3% drinking prediction accuracy. Stakeholder-facing delivery: Published analytical tables, Looker Studio dashboards, and an Astro website explaining the methodology, findings, and prediction demo for non-technical audiences.

projects.name: AI-Enabled Data Management Platform
projects.description: AI-enabled data and microservices platform refactored from a monolith into containerized services with traceable AI Q&A over structured records and semantic-search preparation.
projects.impact: Refactored into a 7-container Docker platform with roughly 10 service endpoints; implemented CRUD, audit, operation logs, and integrated Gemini for natural-language Q&A grounded in database retrieval.
projects.evidence_text: AI-enabled data and microservices platform - React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx, Gemini API, pgvector. Service architecture: Refactored a monolithic API into a 7-container Docker platform with a React frontend, 5 Node.js services, PostgreSQL, Nginx routing, health checks, and roughly 10 service endpoints. CRUD, audit, and traceability: Implemented people-management workflows, filtered reads, operation logs, SQL retrieval, and API contracts designed for integration and maintainability. AI grounded in structured data: Integrated Gemini for natural-language Q&A over structured records and prepared semantic-search support with pgvector while keeping answers traceable and grounded in database retrieval.

projects.name: ClimateWatch Colombia Project
projects.description: Serverless environmental data automation pipeline to ingest external weather and air-quality APIs for Colombian cities with layered storage for traceability.
projects.impact: Built scheduled ingestion collectors and structured S3 storage into raw, curated, and audit layers to support traceability, replay, and failure inspection; designed the pipeline to scale by configuration.
projects.evidence_text: ClimateWatch Colombia Project - Serverless environmental data automation - Python, AWS Lambda, S3, EventBridge, boto3, YAML, Open-Meteo APIs. Scheduled ingestion: Built serverless collectors triggered by EventBridge and AWS Lambda to consume external weather and air-quality APIs for Colombian cities. Layered storage design: Structured S3 storage into raw, curated, and audit layers with timestamped outputs to support traceability, replay, failure inspection, and future extension. Platform thinking: Designed the pipeline to scale by configuration so new cities, variables, or endpoints could be added without reworking the architecture.

projects.name: KyberVPN / Secure Chat Project
projects.description: Experimental secure communications backend and frontend implementing post-quantum key-exchange concepts and encrypted messaging with backend and client-side support.
projects.impact: Developed a backend with 25 API routes across 2 routers for key management, encrypted chat, health/status, and connection flows; implemented post-quantum key exchange and room-key AES-GCM handling.
projects.evidence_text: KyberVPN / Secure Chat Project - Experimental secure communications backend and frontend - Python, FastAPI, React, REST APIs, Kyber, AES-GCM, CORS, uvicorn. Python/FastAPI backend: Developed a backend with 25 API routes across 2 routers plus root endpoints for key management, encrypted chat, health/status monitoring, connection listing, and disconnect flows. Applied cryptography: Implemented post-quantum key-exchange concepts with Kyber, room-key handling with AES-GCM, minimum encrypted-message validation, and structured connection cleanup. Client-side support: Also worked on the React client layer, including connection flows, encryption/decryption utilities, backend interoperability, and secure chat workflows.

experiences.title: Software Engineer - SGM Vehicle Workflow Platform
bullets: Production full-stack platform: Built and maintained an internal operations platform for vehicle-registration and transit-service workflows using React, Electron, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma, centralizing cases, payments, documents, shipments, statuses, services, and reporting.

Functional scale and architecture: Worked across 13 backend modules, 16 Prisma models, 97 route/controller decorators, and 26+ TypeScript/React views connected to JWT-secured REST APIs and desktop IPC authentication flows.

Operational impact: Turned manual workflows into auditable automation through PDF account statements, formula-safe CSV exports, reusable SQL reports, overdue/SLA detection, status history, and controlled file downloads.

Reliability and maintenance: Added bcrypt authentication, throttling, global validation, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, multipart upload docs, and test coverage to improve supportability, onboarding, and long-term maintainability.
